walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Cambridge IGCSE GCSE Music specification.

Component 1: Listening (Western and World Music) appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Component 1: Listening (Western and World Music) in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Cambridge IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 1: Listening (Western and World Music).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
